say:2:1210640001:1.text: I heard from the villagers that you rescued them from the Wights. Well done.
say:2:1210640001:1.source_cn: 我听村民说了，你们从水鬼手中救了他们，做的很好。

say:3:1210640002:1.text: It was all thanks to the help of Magister Merlin! We couldn't have done it without him.
say:3:1210640002:1.source_cn: 得了吧，别用一副是你们拯救了村子的口气说话。你们明明什...
say:3:1210640002:1.male: It was all thanks to the help of Magister Merlin! We couldn't have done it without him.
say:3:1210640002:1.female: It was all thanks to the help of Magister Merlin! We couldn't have done it without her.

say:4:1210640003:0.text: Lucca and I took care of the rest of Tesio's men, Lucca's currently guarding Rustport.
say:4:1210640003:0.source_cn: 我和卢卡收拾了泰西欧的残部，安排好卢卡驻守锈锚港后，才...

say:5:1210640004:0.text: Don't worry, I also left some people to watch over Brineville. The Wights won't dare give them trouble again.
say:5:1210640004:0.source_cn: 你们放心，我留了人在小水村，水鬼不敢再来了。

say:6:1210640005:0.text: Good. You guys should've stepped up for Brineville much earlier.
say:6:1210640005:0.source_cn: 血薇帮要是来得再晚点，就没有小水村了。

say:7:1210640006:0.text: Now that I think about it, it made sense that you guys never helped Brineville.
say:7:1210640006:0.source_cn: 啊，差点忘了，小水村的消失对血薇帮是件好事，对吧？

say:8:1210640007:0.text: Considering that Tesio was the one who screwed those villagers over in the first place...
say:8:1210640007:0.source_cn: 毕竟泰西欧的丑闻，不就是血薇帮的丑闻？

say:9:1210640008:0.text: The Carmine Whispers are under me now. Once we catch Tesio, he'll testify for all his wrongdoings in front of the Laurel Council, including what he did to the people of Brineville.
say:9:1210640008:0.source_cn: 泰西欧现在是血薇帮的通缉犯，我们会抓到他，在乌金议事庭...

say:10:1210640009:0.text: Alright, alright. I gotta admit you are indeed a better leader than Tesio.
say:10:1210640009:0.source_cn: ……不得不承认，你的确是个比泰西欧出色的领导者。

say:14:1210640010:0.text: Now isn't the time to fight each other! The enemy's still out there, we should present a united front with our swords!
say:14:1210640010:0.source_cn: 现在不是吵架的时候……敌人还没有解决，我们的剑应该一致对外！

say:15:1210640011:0.text: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
say:15:1210640011:0.male: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
say:15:1210640011:0.female: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?

choice_prompt:16:1210640011.text: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
choice_prompt:16:1210640011.male: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
choice_prompt:16:1210640011.female: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?

say:20:1210640012:0.text: Miss Sonja, we saw Tesio taking refuge with the Water Wights. What should we do?
say:20:1210640012:0.source_cn: 索尼娅，泰西欧被水鬼救走了，我们接下来怎么办呢？

say:21:1210640013:0.text: Tesio is most likely hiding in their headquarters. Let's go straight there and settle the score.
say:21:1210640013:0.source_cn: 泰西欧应该被救回水鬼帮了，我们直接去水鬼帮大本营，一锅...

say:24:1210640014:0.text: Ha! Never thought I'd see the day the Carmine Whispers would stop being cowards.
say:24:1210640014:0.source_cn: 哈，血薇帮终于不当缩头乌龟了？

say:25:1210640015:0.text: I've had enough of your parroting.

say:26:1210640016:0.text: Are you acting this way because you're in front of the magister? Or are you that desperate to find Nara?
say:26:1210640016:0.source_cn: 是因为有梅林在？还是想去找奈拉？
say:26:1210640016:0.male: Are you acting this way because you're in front of the magister? Or are you that desperate to find Nara?
say:26:1210640016:0.female: Are you acting this way because you're in front of the magister? Or are you that desperate to find Nara?

say:27:1210640017:0.text: I want the Wights to pay for what they've done. Of course, it would also be great if I could figure out what happened to my sister...
say:27:1210640017:0.source_cn: 我要让水鬼为他们做的坏事付出代价，也要搞清楚，奈拉身上...

say:28:1210640018:0.text: Now, do you want to keep questioning me, or should we move on?

say:29:1210640019:0.text: I guess your reasoning makes sense.

say:30:1210640020:0.text: Let's take down the Wights first, cripple the Dead Tide Fleet, and then find their lair and tear it apart!
say:30:1210640020:0.source_cn: 先干掉水鬼帮，断掉死潮舰队一条腿。再找到死潮舰队的老巢...

say:31:1210640021:0.text: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
say:31:1210640021:0.male: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
say:31:1210640021:0.female: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?

choice_prompt:32:1210640021.text: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
choice_prompt:32:1210640021.male: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
choice_prompt:32:1210640021.female: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?

say:33:1210640022:0.text: The Wights' headquarters are at <style="highlight">Lookout Point</style>, it isn't far from here.
say:33:1210640022:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮的大本营在<style=highlight>瞭望...

say:34:1210640023:0.text: We'll need a boat to get there.

say:35:1210640024:0.text: I know a ferry. Follow me!

choice:32:0:1.text: I love a classic revenge tale.
choice:32:0:1.male: I love a classic revenge tale.
choice:32:0:1.female: I love a classic revenge tale.
